series_id.description: Optional series hint; the model may resolve it from the request and workspace.

episode_ids.description: Optional episode hints in any useful representation.

instruction_revision.description: Optional instruction revision or continuation context.

entry_stage_id.description: Optional requested Stage entry; the agent may infer it from available artifacts.

current_artifact_refs.description: Optional existing artifacts in any useful representation.

author_baseline_ref.description: Optional author or series baseline reference.

style_selection.description: Advisory style_id and renderer choice; may be prose or structured data, and is not a launch gate.

requested_quality_scope.description: Optional quality priorities in any useful representation.

human_review_intent.description: Optional human review intent; does not grant authorization.

delivery_intent.description: Optional desired deliverable, audience or platform, and handoff format; freeform or structured and advisory only. If absent, infer from the request and registered workspace contract.
